statement: You are given a non-empty singly linked list whose node values, read from head to tail, are listed in values.
Find the middle node of the list. When the list has an even number of nodes there are two middle nodes; take the second one.
Return the value stored in the middle node.

examples.explanation: With five nodes the middle is the third node, which holds 3.
With four nodes the two middle nodes hold 9 and 10; the second of them, 10, is the answer.

constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [1, 100]
